correctness.rationale: C PASS: finite Fano incidence construction yields 336 automorphisms; generator closure yields exactly 413 subgroups in 23 conjugacy classes; face-orbit model agrees directly with all 3461 original nonempty matching faces tested for each of 22 nonidentity representatives. Every finite certificate collapse is verified. The 21-element involution class collapses to a 4-cycle suspension with an extra length-two path (S1 wedge S2). The 28-element class collapses to a simply connected 2-complex with Euler characteristic 5, with all 23 pi1 generators eliminated by explicit triangle relators (wedge four S2). Others reduce to graphs/discrete/empty. No infinite inference is made.
